How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
To get the best performance and longest lifespan out of a FASS Fuel System, follow these key installation and maintenance practices:
• Proper Installation: Follow the vehicle-specific installation manual provided with your system. Ensure all fittings are properly seated, o-rings are intact and undamaged, and quick-connect fuel lines are fully locked in place (they should resist a gentle pull).
• Prevent Air Leaks: Always double-check suction-side connections. Air leaks or kinked fuel lines are the most common cause of priming issues, air vapor buildup, or hard starts.
Ryan

• Regular Filter Changes: Replace your FASS particulate filters and Extreme Water Separators regularly (typically every 30,000 miles, depending on fuel quality) to protect your injection pump and injectors.
• Winter Maintenance: If you live in a cold climate, drain the water separator regularly to prevent freeze-ups, or add a FASS Electric Heater Probe Kit to avoid fuel gelling.
